note: Toddler-friendly events near Sauvie Island, St. Johns, Portland, Vancouver and the coast, soonest first. Several holiday dates are reported by guides but not yet confirmed by organizers, so check before going.

events.title: Curiosity Kids at OMSI
events.detail: Hands-on 9 to 10 am Saturday sessions for ages 3 to 5 with family, including same-day museum admission: Become a Nature Detective (Oct 31, Nov 21), Design and Discover (Nov 7, Nov 28) and Sasquatch Science Team (Nov 14). Up to 20 people per class.

events.title: Fall Discount Days
events.detail: Connect with nature for $13 admission from 9:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.

events.title: Storytime at Washington County Libraries
events.detail: Various storytimes including Preschool Storytimes and Toddler Times are available for free.

events.title: Monday Mingle
events.detail: Community gathering with coffee and play equipment from 8:30 am to 10:00 am. Free.

events.title: Tree Time! Preschool Walks
events.detail: Guided nature walks and stories at Hoyt Arboretum from 10:00 am to 11:00 am. $5 – $8.

events.title: Tummy Time Connection Circle
events.detail: Postpartum connection and skills for babies through 12 months from 10:00 am to 11:00 am. Free.

events.title: Early Childhood Mandarin Music and Movement Class
events.detail: Mandarin singing and movement class for children six and under from 10:30 am to 11:00 am. Free.

events.title: Gym Open Play at Sellwood Community House
events.detail: Toddler-friendly open play with toys and balls from 10:30 am to 12:30 pm. $8.

events.title: Crowns & Cupcakes
events.detail: Crafting crowns and decorating cupcakes for children aged 2 to 9 from 4:30 pm to 6:00 pm. Free.

events.title: Portland Book Festival
events.detail: The festival features storytimes specifically geared toward ages 4 and up. Free – $20.

events.title: Aspire Dental’s Halloween Candy Buy Back
events.detail: Trade in trick-or-treat candy for cash and prizes. 8:00 am - 5:30 pm, Free.

events.title: Storytime at Washington County Libraries
events.detail: Various storytimes including Toddler Times are available for free.

events.title: Veterans Day
events.detail: Free admission for military members, veterans and their families from 9:30 a.m. to 3:30 p.m.

events.title: ZooLights Sensory-Friendly
events.detail: A sensory-friendly experience for families with different processing needs from 4:30 to 8:30 p.m.

events.title: ZooLights
events.detail: Enjoy dazzling wildlife-inspired light displays and familiar favorites.
